text: He who stands up against the most cruel misfortunes, and overcomes those evils by which others would have been crushed, such a man, I say, turns his misfortunes into badges of honour, because we are so constituted as to admire nothing so much as a man who bears adversity bravely.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
locator: Of Consolation, to his Mother Helvia, Chapter 13
